title: Network: a fourth site theme, its section family, and The Group's Collective with five chapters
detail:
Owner ask 2026-10-13: build The Group (June An's San Diego business community) as a Collective with its chapters as member Spaces, put its events on the calendar and its merch in the store, write every page, and add the handoff's theme to the Frequency theme library as "Network", applied to The Group's website. Follow-up the same day: "Do MANY passes on the theme to make sure it's exactly like the Design System."

SHIPPED 2026-10-13: `network` SiteThemeId (label Network, Modern font set on a synced Space page, Marigold accent default) and the live `Network` editor theme with its theme-contract entry (lib/theme/site-style.ts, lib/sites/editor/*); the palette in four schemes, Marigold, Ocean, Lagoon and Coral, chosen by the owner's accent, plus the pops, tag colors, sand, shapes, waves and motion as one token block (lib/theme/network.ts; the subtle text step moved one shade per scheme to clear AA on the fill); the skin over the house chrome and the page sections (components/sites/network-css.ts); Bricolage Grotesque, Outfit and Instrument Serif on the website root only (components/sites/network-fonts.ts; Caveat is the root layout's); sixteen Network section blocks registered on the website surface (components/page-editor/blocks/network.tsx) with one client island, the countdown; a full-bleed `own` plan kind so a themed block family draws its own band and a Network hero owns the page h1 (lib/sites/menswork-page.ts, components/sites/menswork-page.tsx). The Group: scripts/seed-the-group.mts and its generated scripts/seed-the-group.sql (one idempotent transaction) create the Collective `the-group` on the Network theme, five chapter member Spaces (La Jolla, North Park, Oceanside, North County, Veterans; South OC is a forming circle until its details are confirmed), twelve member-led circles, the Free / Basic / Premium tiers, the three Incubator Studios offerings, four merch products with sizes, and 77 event rows from The Group Portal export (13 recurring series as RRULE anchors with their first 60 days, the rest dated) tenanted to the Collective and hosted by their chapter; six website pages and a Home per chapter, every word from the handoff's site content or written to its voice. Photos and the logo in public/brand/the-group. Fidelity: test/the-group-site.render.test.tsx renders every page through the real chrome and sections; screenshot passes against the handoff's Homepage at 1440 and 390 closed the measured differences (type scale, leading, card shadows, date tiles, bands, waves, footer). NOT applied to production by this PR: the owner runs scripts/seed-the-group.sql, and websitePublished stays off until June confirms the open items (North Park, Oceanside and South OC details, Lisel's spelling, the Most members badge, team emails, the podcast channel URL). Every portal event is seeded, the overnight 12/12 Divine Mother Journey included (owner ruling 2026-10-13). Hotfix 2026-10-14: the published Network home threw on every server render ("Attempted to call wallClockInstant() from the server"), because the blocks called the clock math from the 'use client' countdown module, so the hosted site kept serving its last good page. The clock math moved to lib/time/wall-clock.ts; the probe now fails when the Network blocks import anything but a component from a client module. 2026-10-14: the Network sections render on every theme (a section carries data-nw-island; NETWORK_BLOCK_CSS re-scopes the section rules to it with NETWORK_ISLAND_TOKENS_CSS reading the host theme's colors, faces and accent, added by the site page and the editor canvas only when a page carries a Network section on a non-Network site). The website editor keeps the canvas and the inspector on one selection (lib/sites/editor/field-sync.ts): a click on the page opens and lights its field, a focused field lights its words. The Network fields read as plain names with hints, in page order, the link anchor last, photos through the Loom picker. The Group's tiers are rebuilt on Frequency's own products (any paid tier grants Crew, the Collective membership counts in every chapter, members-only circle, tickets and Journeys) with nothing from the owner's other portal (owner ruling 2026-10-14). 2026-10-14: a Network site's admin links are the Website builder alone (Executive Overview and the Yearly Calendar stay Bold's), drawn as a dark Admin chip with a pencil, apart from the menu and unlike the site's main button. 2026-10-14: the Frequency Space page wears its website's look. Network sections there render inside NetworkPageScope (components/spaces/network-page-scope.tsx: the website sheet on the body only, faces from Google Fonts so no Space route registers them through next/font) or, on a Space whose website wears another theme, in their own island sheet; before this they rendered as bare markup on every in-app tab. The Space's Home tab keeps its own block set (owner, same day): preferences.profileLayout maps each website Home section onto the Space block that carries the same content (seed buildProfileLayout, the copy read off the website doc), with no Network section on the module grid. The adoption ratchet's 11 false shadow-literals hits from --nw-shadow-* are gone (tokens renamed --nw-lift-*, #3427). 2026-10-14 (later): the Space Home was rearranged as one story (owner ask): welcome and join, the proof, the Friday ritual with a first Friday beside June's golden rule, a five-event list beside PitchFest instead of a wall of twelve cards, the chapters, six featured circles, the people, the studio with its podcast, and contact; each chapter opens with room above it. Applied to production and seeded by buildProfileLayout.
